Making calls and the keypad

Güven Phone Help Guide, version 2.0.22

On the Keypad tab, type the number and tap Call (with a screen reader, double-tap).

If you have more than one SIM, you are asked which line to use. To stop being asked every time, set Default calling line in the Phone Settings section of Settings.

The Delete button deletes the last digit; long-press it to delete the whole number.

With Slide to Enter Numbers on, you slide your finger over the keys and the selected digit is entered when you lift it. This setting is in the Accessibility section and works while TalkBack is on.

To save the number you typed, tap Add to contacts, then choose Create new contact or Add to existing contact.

The result of a service code (USSD) is shown in a window; you can take it with Copy.

If the person you call is busy or does not answer, the buttons Call again and Auto redial appear. Auto redial tries up to three times with the same SIM, 10 seconds apart.
